definition: [ שָׁתַק ] verb be quiet (late) (Late Hebrew id., be silent ; Aramaic שְׁתַק , שְׁתֵיק , be quiet, silent (compare also שׁקט )); — Qal Imperfect 3 masculine singular, of sea יִשְׁתֹּק הַיָּם Jonah 1:11 ; Jonah 1:12 (followed by מֵעַל ), of quarrel, strife Prov 26:30 3 masculine plural of persons at sea, יִשְׁתֹּ֑קוּ Ps 107:30 .
